Maharashtra CM visits drought-hit areas, promises farmer relief

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis visited drought-affected areas in Latur, a region experiencing significant crop loss and water shortages. He promised relief to farmers who were seen breaking down during his visit. The visit occurred amidst calls from the opposition to officially declare the state as drought-hit, with government relief measures reportedly underway.
